name: Prime Closet Shelf Bonding (Brush)
intent: Brush one coat of bonding primer on melamine shelves. Fires only when substrate_state is SS_FACTORY_FINISH. Bonding primer is specifically formulated for slick factory-finish surfaces (laminate, melamine, thermofoil).
doctrine: Bonding primer slower than wood primer (70 vs 80 LF/hr) — thicker film required for adhesion on slick surfaces. Material system reference: SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (registered in id_registry, used by SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT).
